frontmatter.sidebar_description: Refresh applied calculated shipping method prices on a draft order.

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `refreshConfirmedDraftOrderShippingMethodsWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

Refreshes the prices of *already-applied* calculated shipping methods on a
draft order from its now-materialized items. Intended to run AFTER an order
change is confirmed (`confirmDraftOrderEditWorkflow`), once item changes are
committed and the materialized order is accurate.

This is the counterpart to [refreshPendingDraftOrderShippingMethodsWorkflow](/references/medusa-workflows/refreshPendingDraftOrderShippingMethodsWorkflow)
(which handles pending, in-flight shipping methods during the edit). Together
they keep calculated prices correct without ever mutating an applied method
for an uncommitted change that could still be cancelled.

Custom-amount and flat-rate methods are left untouched.

steps.description:
This hook is executed before the
calculated shipping methods' prices are refreshed. You can consume it to return
any custom context that is merged into the `context` parameter of the
fulfillment provider's `calculatePrice` method (framework-provided properties
take precedence on a naming conflict).
